name: Zinc oxide (wurtzite B4)
notes: The wurtzite structure uses the ambient internal coordinate of Kisi and Elcombe, Acta Cryst. C 45, 1867-1870 (1989), doi:10.1107/S0108270189004269. The lattice preserves Hanna et al.'s reported c/a ratio and is normalized to their EoS V0.

eos_records.label: Hanna et al. (2011), wurtzite BM2
eos_records.notes: Hanna et al. report V0 = 23.85(6) A^3 per ZnO and K0 = 139(8) GPa with K0' fixed at 4; V0 and its uncertainty are doubled here for the conventional Z=2 cell. The B4-to-B1 transition begins near 8.3 GPa.
